description: Synthetic reading of the upgrade watch (RULES.md 7.2), made from fixtures/live-healthy (every time moved 1800 s later): the authorising block, 3528478, at which System.AuthorizedUpgrade held the 33 bytes the lab read. Read on top of a log holding the upgrade-before reading: it reads back that reading's finalized head, 3528477, and the node gives the hash the log holds. The finalized head is the block named in from_results, best two above it; the runtime version is 1014014. state_getStorage of System.LastRuntimeUpgrade answers {"result":"0xfae33d0030747a6b762d72756e74696d65"}, and of System.AuthorizedUpgrade {"result":"0xfd5ac06d81e461da832c8f83402e155e8eb84cd31a2f08fc3f281cb5fb711e5b01"}; upgrade_answers names where each comes from. Every other value is live-healthy's, made up.
